CANDIDATE_REJECTED: Skip session.restore() on a reconnect when a previous connect succeeded. Rejected because disconnect() only cancels active turns and sets the link CLOSED; it does not invalidate the stored token. restore() always GET /api/app/session and clears the store only on local expiry or HTTP 401. Skipping restore() on a later connect() would keep a revoked-but-unexpired token treated as valid. The second /api/app/session call is the fail-closed revalidation, not redundant work.
